releaseNotes.dateLabel: 3 November 2026
releaseNotes.summary: Established GitHub version-control baseline and field-tested structural logging.
changes: Project Workbook now exports curated engineering columns, not cloud IDs and JSON import provenance; investigation-specific blank columns are omitted; searchable worksheet filters; structural resolved geological origin included; non-oriented Beta not represented as valid.

Spreadsheet importer recognises additional BH/TP column headings, keeps editable worksheet/header/field mapping, shows confirmation/preflight counts, automatically skips existing/overlapping geological and coring intervals, and aborts when a local pre-import checkpoint cannot be created. This release deliberately does not automatically merge or replace conflicting geology.
Omega multi-sheet importer now skips matching or overlapping geology records rather than appending known duplicates.
Structural form order puts Infill/Thickness before Gamma/Geological Origin.
Beta disabled for Spun/Not Oriented in add/edit; existing old Beta values preserved rather than destroyed; orientation confidence defaults remain.

Theme text contrast strengthened; JARVIS label replaced with Core Mode; branded app installation icon restored while the distinctive new tent/strata Core remains in sidebar as a responsive sync indicator.

Logger and Data Review editors now share ordered field definitions. Coring edit mirrors From/To, measured recovered lengths and fracture count, followed by calculated read-only Run Length / TCR% / SCR% / RQD% / FF and run comments.

Coring derived fields recalculate live and cannot be changed directly. On save, recovery totals are recalculated from measurements, invalid or overlapping intervals are rejected before mutating the original record.
Structural editing keeps the requested field order, orientation Beta lockout and controlled inputs.
Primary application icon remains the original StrataBase SB mark, including new padded maskable icons. The Core is a secondary navigation/status symbol.

Editing: field ordering now follows primary input order for coring, geology, structure, test pits, samples, groundwater, etc., where those fields are present. Coring editor computes run length and recovery percentages from editable depths/recovery totals; calculated fields are read-only. Coring edits validate against overlapping intervals and improbable measurements before saving.
Data Review shares the logging editor's input-field definitions. Recognised sample categories and groundwater rates retain dropdowns, and dates use date inputs.

releaseNotes.dateLabel: Historical build · date not independently confirmed
releaseNotes.summary: An intermediate early StrataBase iteration.
changes: Existing infrastructure configured: targets the existing https://app.stratabase.co.za website and existing Supabase project ttgdyhycaxbrysveyusi, using its browser-safe public publishable key. The domain and Google OAuth settings are not recreated.
Authentication: StrataBase branded Google sign-in; server-authorised organisation role gate; returning approved device retains local/offline access.

Offline: no CDN runtime dependency; XLSX engine, JS, styles, fonts/images/icons and app assets are self-contained in the PWA cache. New cache name to force update without clearing user storage. A trusted device and proper backup remain necessary.

Interface decisions: dashboard kept logging-focused; account/offline/sync/backup settings in Account & Device; hidden system metadata; Clear/Cancel; + New Test Pit; legitimate multiple joints at one horizon; faint horizontally centred Iron Man reactor symbol in sidebar.

Omega importer: recognises the real v20 export and maps boreholes/coring/geotech/structures. Run QC and Export Audit excluded. Original source-cell values and provenance retained. Tested against the actual 2026-11-02 workbook: 6 holes, 439 coring runs, 175 geotech intervals, 1,128 structures; reimport skipped all 1,742 source records.

Data recovery fix: downloaded StrataBase Recovery Checkpoint JSON is now accepted by the JSON restore importer, subject to organisation check and a protected pre-restore checkpoint. This corrects a v0.9.0 gap.
Google Drive: feature code provided separately in backend source package. Explicitly disabled in public configuration until verified. App does not report an unconfigured archive as active.

changes: Professional Continue with Google sign-in gate before accessing the workspace. Access is granted only when an administrator has added the Google user's UUID to sb_memberships in Supabase. No application-side signup or organisation creation. Returning approved devices may open offline with cached approval.

Account & Device in the sidebar: organisation identity, cloud sync, unresolved conflicts, end-device offline checks, local checkpoint controls, Google Drive archive controls, legacy project migration and Omega workbook import link. The logging dashboard no longer carries the device status card.
Subtle, near-transparent arc-reactor / triangular forge easter egg, centered in the sidebar, not in exported reports.

Offline-first account-scoped IndexedDB snapshot storage, plus per-account recovery checkpoints and backup export. The XLSX parser/writer is shipped inside the app: no external JavaScript, CDN, or Internet connection is necessary for Excel functions in a supported browser.

Cloud database schema and Row Level Security (RLS); organisation-scoped projects, locations, records; compare-and-swap (CAS) revision checking; collision/conflict review; deletions represented by tombstones. This needs live multi-device integration testing before use on irreplaceable data.

Organisation-owned Google Drive backup backend (Supabase Edge Function), capable of creating SHA-256-labelled backups, listing archives, checksum-verifying downloads, and supplying JSON files compatible with StrataBase's restore path. Google sign-in and the Google Drive service account are separate integrations.

Omega Logger XLSX / CSV migration wizard, with sheet detection, editable dataset classification, borehole defaults, depth validation, 1,000+ row support, preflight totals/warnings, no silent removal of same-depth joint measurements, idempotence by source file + sheet + row where possible, and a protected pre-import checkpoint. Original sheet values and provenance are retained with records.
